summary: Per-entity list of sound switches (switch group + value) set because of the entity's tags (eoc::TagComponent) on sound-activated entities that are neither characters nor items (macOS query: TagComponent + SoundActivatedComponent, without Character/Item, writing TagSwitchDataComponent). Element type is the game's ecl::sound::TagSwitchData (macOS DynamicArray<ecl::sound::TagSwitchData>), the same element as in ecl::sound::TagSwitchRequestsSingletonComponent (layout in se-fork\coverage\layouts, struct TagSwitchRequestData {FixedString Switch; FixedString Value}). Never seen alive. Registry total 16 (client row).

fields.name: Switch
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x1F2F630 appends an element (stride 8) and stores the FixedString at +0x30 of the tag's sound record (IncRef). Same element (ecl::sound::TagSwitchData) as TagSwitchRequestsSingletonComponent, where +0 is the switch group name.

fields.name: Value
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x1F2F630 stores the FixedString at +0x34 of the same record into element+4 (IncRef), then passes both to FUN_141f2fd20 (sets the switch).

fields.name: Switches
fields.evidence: Creator bg3.exe+0x1F30210 (AllocRaw 0x10) zeroes pointer + capacity + size. Destructor bg3.exe+0x69E8F0 calls bg3.exe+0x5C8AF0(p,0) (shrink: destroys elements with stride 8 via FUN_1405c3690 - two FixedStrings) and frees the buffer. Writer bg3.exe+0x1F2F630 (PointAndClick/tag sound code) grows it (capacity +8, size +0xC) and fills elements of 8 bytes; it removes the component when no switch was added.
